title: Life Skills for Independence: Money, Time, and Self-Management
summary: Many young people enter university or the workforce without basic skills: managing expenses, simple cooking, organizing time, or booking an appointment. These are not details but pillars of independence. Hand your child gradual responsibilities now while they are in your home, so they may make mistakes in safety, rather than learning them alone far from you.
try_this: This week: Hand your child a complete life task (managing a weekly budget, cooking a meal, or scheduling an appointment) from start to finish.
reflection_prompts: Which life skill does your child lack?
How did your child handle the responsibility you entrusted to them?
